column5: THE FEE QUESTION IS ALREADY DECIDED - Casey, 2026-09-14: "Cross-chain Trench buy: SKAI fee on swap/trade leg only; bridge hop fee-free." SKAI takes its fee once, on the swap or trade into the token, and the bridge hop charges no SKAI fee, which keeps the standing rule that deposits are advertised fee-free. That rule has been violated once before (10bps charged on the deposit leg, on both layers) and had to be reverted, so it belongs in the spec explicitly rather than left to the implementer. The work is tracked as skai-interface#1286 and depends on the audited single-transaction fee router. Nothing on this row is inside this lane's owns list - it is rails, an edge function and a wallet router, none of them src/components/trench-redesign/**.
